summary_bullets: Relax /design and /implement review loops to single-round convergence with at most five non-nit accepted findings and zero important findings
Remove LARCH_DESIGN_CONVERGENCE_THRESHOLD, --convergence-threshold, and CONVERGENCE_STREAK machinery; hardcode the bound at five with nit-severity findings excluded from the count
Refresh docs, harnesses, and approval-gates prose; offline harnesses cover nit-only, five- and six-finding boundaries, and degraded-round behavior
commit_message:
Relax review-loop convergence to single round with ≤5 non-nit accepted

Replace two-round streak convergence (≤3 accepted) with one non-degraded round
(≤5 non-nit accepted, 0 important; nits unbounded) in plan-review-loop.sh and
review-and-fix.sh. Drop LARCH_DESIGN_CONVERGENCE_THRESHOLD and --convergence-threshold.
Update SKILL/docs/harnesses and approval-gates loop-internal carve-out prose.

Inline-triage rule 1: approval-gates.md still referenced removed env var.
